summary: The case now reaches grease application, then first diverges when C waits for the next turn message. Applying grease to bare hands activates Glib; allmain.c calls do_wear.c:glibr(), which drops the unwelded quarterstaff. source.branch: After apply.c:use_grease() activates Glib on bare hands, the paid turn reaches allmain.c:moveloop_core -> glibr(). With no gloves, slipping rings, or offhand weapon, glibr() takes its primary weapon branch for the non-AKLYS, unwelded quarterstaff, prints the slip message, clears uwep, and drops it.
callers: C: allmain.c:moveloop_core calls do_wear.c:glibr() under if (Glib) after turn advancement and before nh_timeout(); wire the equivalent at that source-order boundary in js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurn.

dependencies: Preserve glibr branch order and shared equipment state: uarmg, uleft/uright, u.twoweap, uswapwep, uwep, welded(), bimanual(), canletgo(), Ring_off(), setuswapwep(), and setuwep() determine which items fall.

Keep glibr before nh_timeout in elapsed-turn planning and live execution. Its second message must reach the existing TTY path before later upkeep.
